subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification: GPU type & throughput targets
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@finlytics.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity discussion follow-up

Hi Marissa / Marcus,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to understand how Redwood Dedicated could map to our production needs. Attached is a quick workbook with our estimated monthly token volumes and a short RFI with security questions we flagged. A few clarifying items from our side before we get to formal pricing: 

- Target throughput: we need to sustain ~120 tokens/sec across peak windows for our chat routing (approx. 10T/s per API instance, ~12 instances during peak).
- Token volumes: attached sheet has 3 scenarios (Baseline: 150M tokens/mo, Growth: 400M tokens/mo, Aggressive: 1.1B tokens/mo).
- Preferred GPU: our infra team prefers A10G-like performance for cost reasons but is open to A100 for latency-critical paths if justified.
- Budget: our procurement guide targets unit economics around $700-$900 per 1M tokens for POC, with long-term target closer to $500/1M as we optimize.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood can provide a dedicated pool sized to our Growth scenario, 2) indicative $/1M token ranges by GPU class (A10G vs A100) for reserved monthly capacity, and 3) any minimum commitment term you require for those rates?

If easier, happy to do a quick 15-min price call early next week.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Turner
Head of Platform
FinLytics

Attachments: FinLytics_Monthly_Usage_Estimates.xlsx, RFI_Security_QA.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity discussion follow-up

Hi Olivia — really appreciate the workbook and the clear asks. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Recap:
- Growth scenario ~400M tokens/mo. Peak sustained throughput ~120 tokens/sec.
- GPU preference: A10G for cost, A100 for latency-critical.
- Budget target: $700-$900 / 1M tokens (POC) and aspirational $500 / 1M long-term.

What I can do now:
- Loop in Marcus (cc'd) and Rishi from pricing to map the Growth scenario to our reserved capacity options (GPU type, slot count, expected sustained throughput).
- Share a short pro forma with 2 sizing options: (A) cost-optimized (A10G flavor) and (B) latency-optimized (A100 flavor), each with expected $/1M token deliverable.
- Flag procurement questions (term minimums, ramp clauses) based on your budget targets.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marcus/Rishi provide sizing + ballpark pricing by Tue EOD (we'll include assumptions for batch/hyphenation rates and KV cache hit).
2) If ballpark matches, schedule a 30-min technical + procurement alignment next week to confirm SLA and order form.

Does Tue for the pricing doc work for you? If so, I'll ask Marcus to include throughput assumptions (tokens/sec per reserved GPU slot) so you can validate with your infra team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@finlytics.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity discussion follow-up

Thanks, Marissa / Olivia — looping Rishi to provide the sizing and pricing pro forma. Summary of what I'll run in the calc (assumptions below):

Assumptions to validate:
- Model family: 7B chat model, average generation per request 40 tokens, average prompt length 60 tokens -> ~100 tokens per API call.
- Peak requests: ~12 concurrent instances * 10 req/sec * 100 tokens = 12,000 tokens/sec peak across fleet -> but Olivia specified 120 tokens/sec sustained per instance earlier; reconciling, we'll size for the per-instance 120 t/s and the aggregate in the workbook.
- KV cache & prefix hit: assume 20% effective token reduction on average.
- Batching: continuous batching expected; effective throughput improvement factor ~1.6 during non-latency-critical paths.

Pro forma items Rishi will produce:
- Reserved pool sizing (number of slots) for Growth (400M/mo) on A10G and A100 variants.
- Expected sustained tokens/sec per reserved slot (conservative and optimistic).
- Estimated $/1M tokens for reserved monthly pricing tiers (monthly commit, 12-month/36-month tiers).
- Minimums: we typically require a 3-month minimum on reserved capacity; most favorable per-unit pricing at 12-36 month commitments.

Rishi — can you produce the two sizing + pricing scenarios by Tue EOD? I'll keep Olivia cc'd so they have the numbers for procurement review.

—Marcus
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@finlytics.ai>

Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity discussion follow-up

Marissa / Marcus / Rishi — thanks for the quick coordination. Tue works for the pro forma. A couple of small clarifications ahead of your calc: 

- The 120 tokens/sec number I quoted was per-app instance (we run ~12 instances on peak), so aggregate peak is ~1,440 tokens/sec. Our Growth sheet assumes daily burst smoothing but would like conservative sizing for sustained peak windows.
- For budgeting, the $700-$900 / 1M tokens is our POC target; procurement will stretch to $1,000/1M for a short POC if we get a path to $500/1M within 12 months.
- We're flexible on a 3-6 month initial term for the POC; longer terms are acceptable for better pricing.

If you can include both per-slot throughput (tokens/sec) and expected monthly token capacity per slot in the pro forma that would help our SREs map to expected instance counts. Looking forward to Tue's numbers.

Best,
Olivia Turner
Head of Platform, FinLytics
